Your Habits note now has a habit tracker page. I haven't opened it on a phone, so I haven't seen how it looks there.

- **Your data:** I turned your daily lines (Mon 28 Sep to Sun 4 Oct) into a table with one column per habit: Walk, Read, Stretch and No phone in bed. Your side comments, like "too tired" and "party", are gone from the note. The original text is in the note's history if you want it back.
- **Ticking:** Today's habits show as big tap targets. Tapping one ticks it and writes to the table, and tapping again unticks it.
- **Streaks:** Each habit shows how many days in a row you've done it.
- **Last 14 days:** A grid shows which days you did each habit.
- **Weekly goals:** Each habit has a progress bar for the week. I set every goal to 7 days a week as a placeholder. You can change them on the page.

Today (5 Oct) has no row yet, so your first tick will create it.
